# ankra_cost_budget (Resource)

A monthly cost budget for one scope: the organisation, a project, a cluster, an environment label or an application. Each scope has at most one budget. The counterpart of `ankra cost budgets set` and `ankra cost budgets delete`; changing a budget needs the `billing.manage` permission.

The platform has no read by id, so the budget is read from the listing. A token that may not list the whole organisation sees only its own project's budgets; a budget missing from that partial listing is reported as an error rather than re-created. A cluster or application budget whose scope is deleted drops out of the listing, so the next plan re-creates it and the platform refuses that: remove such a budget from configuration together with its scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cost_budget" "organisation" {
  name          = "Whole organisation"
  scope_kind    = "organisation"
  monthly_cents = 2500000
  currency      = "eur"
}

resource "ankra_cost_budget" "production" {
  name          = "Production"
  scope_kind    = "environment"
  scope_id      = "production"
  monthly_cents = 1500000
  currency      = "eur"
  notify_at_pct = 90
  owner_user_id = "33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `currency` (String) Currency code of the budget, such as `eur` or `usd`; the platform stores it lower-cased.
- `monthly_cents` (Number) Monthly budget in cents of `currency`. Must be positive.
- `name` (String) Budget name, 1 to 120 characters.
- `scope_kind` (String) What the budget covers: `organisation`, `project`, `cluster`, `environment` or `application`. A budget's scope cannot change, so changing it replaces the budget.

### Optional

- `notify_at_pct` (Number) Percent of the budget at which the owner is told, 1 to 100. Defaults to `80`.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Ankra user id of the member told about the budget. Removing it clears the owner.
- `scope_id` (String) The project, cluster or application id, or the environment label (stored lower-cased). Leave unset for an `organisation` budget. Changing it replaces the budget.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the budget.
- `scope_name` (String) Display name of the scope; empty for a cluster or application the organisation no longer has.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Cost budgets are imported by budget id, as `ankra cost budgets list` prints it.
terraform import ankra_cost_budget.production 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
